articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (InvenTrust or the Company), today announced that Neil Soskin has been appointed Senior Vice President, Portfolio Management for InvenTrust. Mr. Soskin joins InvenTrust with more than 30 years of experience in the real estate industry, including extensive understanding of leasing, acquisitions and new development. This Smart News Release features multimedia. View the full release here: http://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20170126005980/en/ (Photo: Business Wire) Mr. Soskin previously served as Vice President, Real Estate for Primestor Development Inc., which engages in the acquisition, development, rehabilitation, leasing, and management of commercial properties. Prior to Primestor, he was Vice President / Director, Western Region, at Weingarten Realty Investors, where he was responsible for leading the Western Region.
